meta.title: Rust Garden
meta.words: v2: the woodblocks, the metallic ping (now a struck plate) and the toms are now the native ones you preferred in the lab; otherwise as v1. Broken beat, nearly one chord: F# minor 11 for six bars, E 6/9 for two. The broken kick and toms rolling through the gaps, the octave funk on the round bass, woodblocks in threes, a metallic ping, dotted chords late.
